faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept JazzCash, Easypaisa, major credit/debit cards, and Cash on Delivery.
Orders are typically delivered within 3–5 business days across Pakistan.
Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition with tags attached.
Currently we ship within Pakistan only. International shipping is coming soon.

products.name: Mustard Floral Embroidered Kurta
products.description: A rich mustard kurta with dense floral thread embroidery running edge to edge, finished with a Mandarin collar and fabric-covered buttons. The soft cotton base and full sleeves make it a lovely festive wearing kurta for shadi, baraat, and family gatherings.
products.care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash on delicate cycle. Wash with similar colors and use a mild detergent only. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat from the reverse side and hang to dry in shade.

products.name: Peacock Blue Mirror-Work Kurta
products.fabric: Embroidered Cotton Silk with Mirror Work
products.description: A vibrant peacock blue kurta with hand-placed mirror work and floral thread motifs running down the placket and scattered across the body. The Mandarin collar and straight cut give it a clean, traditional silhouette — a festive wearing kurta that's perfect for shadi, baraat, and family celebrations.
products.care: Dry clean recommended to protect the mirror work and embroidery. If hand washing, use cold water only and avoid wringing. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat, avoiding direct contact with the embroidery, and hang to dry in shade.

products.care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash on delicate cycle. Wash with similar colors and use a mild detergent only. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat and hang to dry in shade.

products.name: Sage Green Sequin Embroidered Kurta
products.description: A sage green kurta with dense golden paisley and floral embroidery finished with fine sequin work, covering the body edge to edge. The heavily embroidered Mandarin collar and fabric buttons make this the pick as a festive wearing kurta for shadi, baraat, and big-occasion wedding dressing.

products.name: Aqua Embroidered Panel Kurta
products.description: An aqua kurta with tonal floral embroidery running in vertical panels down the front and along the cuffs, finished with a matching embroidered Mandarin collar. A lighter take on festive embroidery — a festive wearing kurta that still stands out for shadi, baraat, and family events.

products.name: Navy Sequin Embroidered Kurta
products.description: A navy blue kurta covered in fine floral thread and sequin embroidery, with a sheer net inset at the collar for a delicate finishing touch. Fabric-covered buttons and a classic straight cut make it a dependable festive wearing kurta for shadi and baraat.
products.care: Dry clean recommended to protect the embroidery, sequins, and net inset. If hand washing, use cold water only and avoid wringing. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat, avoiding direct contact with the embroidery, and hang to dry in shade.

products.name: Royal Blue Zari Booti Kurta

products.name: Ivory Sequin Embroidered Sherwani
products.description: An ivory sherwani jacket with dense sequin and thread embroidery in a scalloped motif, finished with a Mandarin collar, brooch-style button closures, and a mock pocket square. Structured and formal, this sherwani is tailored for shadi and baraat — the little groom's outfit for the biggest day on the calendar.
products.care: Dry clean only. Store on a padded hanger or folded flat away from direct sunlight. Avoid contact with perfume or water, as this may mark the embroidery.

products.name: Pistachio Self-Striped Kurta
products.description: A soft pistachio-green kurta in a subtle self-striped weave, finished with a Mandarin collar and matching fabric buttons. Minimal and versatile, it's an easy everyday pick that layers well under a waistcoat as a festive wearing kurta for smaller shadi and baraat occasions too.

products.name: Maroon Leaf Vine Embroidered Kurta
products.description: A deep maroon kurta covered edge to edge in a fine white leaf-and-vine schiffli print, finished with a Mandarin collar and a neat button placket. The dense all-over pattern gives it a lace-like, cutwork finish, making this a striking festive wearing kurta for shadi, baraat, and Eid gatherings.
products.care: Gentle hand wash or machine wash on delicate cycle. Wash with similar colors and use a mild detergent only. Do not bleach. Iron on low heat and hang to dry in shade.

products.name: Powder Blue Self-Textured Kurta

products.name: Mustard Bead-Embroidered Waistcoat Set
products.description: A festive two-piece set in warm mustard, pairing a sleeveless Mandarin-collar waistcoat with colorful bead-embroidered motifs — elephants, tassels, and an umbrella — over a matching full-sleeve kurta. Finished with statement metal buttons, this playful folk-inspired set is built for shadi, baraat, and Eid celebrations.
products.care: Dry clean only to protect the bead embroidery. Store on a padded hanger or folded flat away from direct sunlight. Avoid contact with perfume or water, as this may mark the embroidery.

products.name: Blush Pink Embroidered Sherwani Jacket
products.description: A blush pink sherwani jacket covered edge to edge in dense tone-on-tone floral panel embroidery, finished with a Mandarin collar, a single statement button closure, and a mock pocket square. Structured and richly detailed, this sherwani is tailored for shadi and baraat — a standout look for the little groom's big day.
